csm_maya: Heads up — Thornfield onboarding e2e tests are showing median latency ~220ms at peak vs our target ~80ms. Saw the spike during summary calls. Proactive idea: short canary to try int8 quant + route tail traffic to a compact model. Thoughts?
eng_infra_jamie: I noticed staging traces have low KV cache hit on their query patterns, so batching isn't helping much. Could be prefix variance.
ml_eng_rafael: +1 for canary. Suggest primary -> redwood/compact-2-int8 and fallback -> redwood/base-1. Keep 5% traffic for 30m, monitor latency + quality. Quick config idea:
```
routing:
  - match: request.latency_estimate > 150
    route: redwood/compact-2-int8
    fallback: redwood/base-1
quantization: int8
canary: 5%
```
success_manager_li: I'll coordinate the window with Thornfield PM. Also can capture post-canary feedback and add to the onboarding playbook.
customer_contact_ash: Thornfield is ok with a 30-min window tomorrow 09:00 PT. They asked for a quick note on rollback criteria.
eng_oncall_sam: Rollback triggers: 95th latency > +50ms vs baseline OR hallucination eval failure rate > 10% on the eval set. Also add automated alert to #eng-oncall.
csm_maya: Good — I'll add those triggers to the runbook. Linking internal playbook for reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/perf-quant-routing (for our notes).
ml_eng_rafael: Small prod-safe prompt tweak to reduce context length might help too: set `max_context_tokens: 1024` for summary tasks to lower average tokens and KV churn.
eng_infra_jamie: I'll prepare a canary image and the traffic split config. Will tag the canary as `thornfield-quant-canary-4012345678`.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: canary created -> thornfield-quant-canary-4012345678, scheduled for 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z.
csm_maya: Capturing this thread into the renewal dashboard as a proactive optimization win if metrics improve. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
success_manager_li: I'll collect customer feedback post-canary and log any qualitative changes (payloads/edge cases) into the ticket.
eng_oncall_sam: After canary, let's run a small offline hallucination eval set against compact-2-int8 and base-1 and compare. I'll trigger the job.
customer_contact_ash: Perfect — Thornfield wants a short summary after the run. Please include cost delta if possible.
csm_maya: Will do. Updating the onboarding checklist and closing loop after post-mortem.
